name: trueguard
description: Understand an RWA, verify product rights against user intent, and help small holders pool compatible exits.

tools.name: trueguard_explain_asset
tools.description: Explain the real asset, separate live operations from future claims, and return cited evidence.

tools.name: trueguard_check_intent
tools.description: Deterministically compare a user's words with the exact rights of an RWA product.

tools.name: trueguard_get_exit_routes
tools.description: Return exit routes, estimated net proceeds, assumptions, minimums and restrictions.

tools.name: trueguard_quote_exit_together
tools.description: Estimate how a small RWA sell order changes when it joins a compatible larger ExitTogether batch.

tools.name: trueguard_execution_providers
tools.description: Return execution-provider readiness, exact scope, requirements, limitations and primary sources without treating configured infrastructure as product eligibility.

tools.name: trueguard_get_onchain_batch
tools.description: Read the current ExitTogether batch state directly from the X Layer coordinator.
